content.description: Once businesses join our platform, we will tokenize their business and provide them an easy to use interface where they will be able to manage their business tokens. On our site they will be able to sell their tokens to investors, allowing them to get easy access to funding Users will be able to deposit into our platform through different cryptocurrencies, but all tokens will be bought in a stable coin. In order to prevent wallet variations on investors and business fundings all orders will be on stable coins.
